sections.title: The Dag Model

paragraphs.text: A Dag is a workflow defined as Python code: its schedule, its tasks, and the dependencies between them. The Dag file is a definition that the scheduler parses; it does not execute at parse time. This is the central mental shift: the file describes the workflow, and the scheduler decides what runs and when.
paragraphs.explainArabic: Dag هو سير عمل معرّف ككود Python: جدوله، مهامه، وتبعياته. ملف Dag هو تعريف يحلّله المجدول؛ لا يُنفَّذ أثناء التحليل.

paragraphs.text: Each schedule interval produces one Dag run with its own logical date, state, and logs. Catchup fills every missed interval between the start date and now; setting catchup to false runs only the latest interval. Choose catchup based on whether each missed interval carries real value: an invoices pipeline must catch up, a repo re-ingest does not.
paragraphs.explainArabic: كل فاصل زمني ينتج تشغيل Dag واحد (Dag run) مع تاريخ منطقي وحالة وسجلات. catchup يملأ كل فاصل فائت؛ false يشغّل الأحدث فقط.

paragraphs.text:
from airflow.sdk import DAG, task

with DAG(dag_id="devmate_ingest", start_date=datetime(2026,1,1),
         schedule="0 3 * * *", catchup=False):
    up = BashOperator(task_id="start_qdrant", bash_command="docker compose up -d qdrant")

    @task
    def ingest() -> str: ...

    up >> ingest()
paragraphs.code:
from airflow.sdk import DAG, task

with DAG(dag_id="devmate_ingest", start_date=datetime(2026,1,1),
         schedule="0 3 * * *", catchup=False):
    up = BashOperator(task_id="start_qdrant", bash_command="docker compose up -d qdrant")

    @task
    def ingest() -> str: ...

    up >> ingest()

keySentences: A Dag is a workflow defined as Python code: its schedule, its tasks, and the dependencies between them.
The Dag file is a definition that the scheduler parses; it does not execute at parse time.
takeaways: A Dag file is a definition, not a program.
One Dag run per schedule interval, identified by its logical date.
catchup is a business decision, not a default.

studyAid.whyItMatters: Treating the Dag file as a program is the most common beginner mistake; parse-time code runs on every scheduler cycle.

confusion.simpleEnglish: The file describes the workflow. The scheduler runs it.
confusion.simpleArabic: الملف يصف سير العمل. المجدول يشغّله.
confusion.analogy: A recipe describes a dish; the chef cooks it.

sections.title: Tasks, Data, and Scheduling

paragraphs.text: Tasks are declared with operators or the TaskFlow API. TaskFlow turns plain functions into tasks and infers dependencies from argument passing; those functions stay testable with pytest. XCom carries small metadata between tasks through the metadata database; large data flows through storage with only the reference in XCom.
paragraphs.explainArabic: المهام تُعرَّف بـ operators أو TaskFlow. TaskFlow يحوّل الدوال إلى مهام ويستنتج التبعيات. XCom ينقل بيانات وصفية (metadata) بين المهام.

paragraphs.text: Sensors wait for conditions in poke, reschedule, or deferrable mode. Deferrable mode suspends the task and hands the wait to the triggerer, so a long wait holds no worker slot. Assets let a Dag schedule on a dataset update event instead of a clock, stating the data dependency in code.
paragraphs.explainArabic: Sensors تنتظر شروطًا. الوضع deferrable يعلّق المهمة ويسلّم الانتظار إلى triggerer. Assets تسمح بالجدولة على تحديث dataset.

paragraphs.text: Backfill re-runs a Dag over a historical range and is only safe on an idempotent pipeline. Retries, execution timeouts, and SLAs are three separate levers that must be configured together: a retry without a timeout can hang forever, and a timeout without a retry decision is an accident.
paragraphs.explainArabic: Backfill يعيد تشغيل Dag على مدى تاريخي، آمن فقط على pipeline idempotent. retries و timeouts و SLAs تُضبط معًا.

keySentences: TaskFlow turns plain functions into tasks and infers dependencies from argument passing.
XCom carries small metadata between tasks; large data flows through storage.
takeaways: XCom is metadata; storage is data.
Long waits belong in deferrable sensors, never poke mode.

studyAid.whyItMatters: Most production incidents come from XCom abuse and unbounded retries; these rules prevent them.

confusion.simpleEnglish: Pass references, not payloads. Bound every wait.
confusion.simpleArabic: مرّر مراجع، لا حمولات. اربط كل انتظار بحد.
confusion.analogy: A courier carries an address, not the furniture.

prediction.answer: It serializes into the metadata database and becomes a bottleneck at every task boundary.
